name: Fuse or persist batch-1 decode projections
source_model_term: Nsight cublas_gemvx time across 114 decode projections
hypothesis: Remove launch and intermediate traffic across related projections instead of replacing isolated cuBLAS GEMVs.
derivation: Nsight observes 21,204 cuBLAS GEMV launches over 186 decode steps (5.036 ms/step); reachable isolated replacements delivered only about 0.37 ms of modeled kernel savings, bounding the likely interval below the 0.8 ms discovery ceiling.

evidence.claim: Runtime launch counts, logical shape mapping and reachable-candidate residuals.
